newsitem.title: USA: Hadco gets $250 mln in revolving credit.
newsitem.headline: Hadco gets $250 mln in revolving credit.

text.p: Hadco Corp said it entered a $250 million revolving credit facility with The First National Bank of Boston to complete its proposed acquisition of Zycon Corp..
Hadco said on December 5 it would buy Zycon for about $205 million in cash, or $18.00 a share.
The facility ends Hadco's existing revolving credit and term loan agreement, the company said. Terms of the facility were not given. Company officials were not immediately available to comment.

The company also said its waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust relating to the acquisition expired. The company said it did not receive a request for additional information from either the Federal Trade Commission or the Antitrust Division of the Justice Department.
Hadco makes electronic interconnect products. Zycon is a California-based printed circuit board maker.
